race.description: Wagga Wagga Early Years Learning Centre Hcp (C2)
race.comment: JUDITH'S REVENGE (2) is a specialist on her home track and while she's yet to score fresh, she was in the placings over this track and trip when resuming last prep. Can return with a bang off a short break. KOOL KADE (10) was much better second-up at Nowra when leading them up. Expecting him to give a bold sight. RIVERBEND UNICORN (5) was a good winner first-up at Gundagai when sprinting. Was expecting to see him stretch further second-up. Deserves respect nevertheless. HOT TODDY (7) finally got off the mark last month and then quickly made it two on the bounce here. Struggled last time but is worth keeping safe.
